title: Ukrinform War (ukrinform.net) reports nine people injured in Russian strikes across Kharkiv Oblast on November 20
summary: Ukrinform War (ukrinform.net) reports nine people injured in Russian strikes across Kharkiv Oblast on November 20, 2026. The report cites Kharkiv prosecutors describing drone and cluster-munition attacks on Kharkiv, Besarabivka, and Barvinkove. The body itemizes fewer injuries than the headline, so the summary keeps the headline figure attributed to the source.
contents:
## Event
Ukrinform War (ukrinform.net) reports nine people injured in Russian strikes on Kharkiv and the surrounding region on Friday, November 20. The report cites the office of the Kharkiv Regional Prosecutor, which described the attacks on Telegram. According to that account, enemy drones struck a settlement in the suburbs of Kharkiv in the evening and injured six people, including two boys aged 12 and 14. Earlier in the day, a strike preliminarily identified as a Geran-4 drone hit the Saltivskyi district of Kharkiv, damaged two apartment buildings, a car, and a power line, and injured two men. The report also describes a Geran-5 drone strike in the village of Besarabivka, which damaged residential buildings and a car, and a multiple-launch rocket system firing a cluster munition at Barvinkove, which damaged eight households.

## Location and Time
The report places these strikes across Kharkiv Oblast in northeastern Ukraine. The named locations include the suburbs of Kharkiv city, the Saltivskyi district of Kharkiv, the village of Besarabivka in Berestyn district, and the town of Barvinkove in Izium district. The point uses the Kharkiv Oblast centroid from the geocoder, so it marks the bounded regional area and not any single strike site. The article carries a publication time of 21:12 UTC on November 20, 2026. It gives times of 9:40 and 14:15 without a time zone and offers no exact occurrence time for the evening suburban attack, so date_event remains omitted.

## Evidence
The primary source consists of the Ukrinform article published at 21:12 UTC on November 20, 2026, which relays statements from the office of the Kharkiv Regional Prosecutor on Telegram. The article also cites preliminary drone identifications from the authorities and notes that prosecutors opened pre-trial investigations under Part 1 of Article 438 of the Criminal Code of Ukraine, which covers war crimes. The qualification did not check any independent second outlet or official notice, so the account rests on one publisher relaying prosecutorial statements. The queued candidate URL and the original report share one article, so the links list contains a single distinct URL.

## Allied Relevance
United States and allied planners could use this dated record to track reported Geran drone use against Kharkiv Oblast and cluster-munition rocket fire in Izium district. Air-defence and munitions analysts could compare the reported drone types, strike locations, and damage patterns against regional air-defence coverage. Humanitarian and legal reviewers could also use the documented casualty figures and the pre-trial war-crimes investigations that prosecutors reportedly opened.

## Confidence and Gaps
This record carries moderate confidence because a single publisher relays prosecutorial statements and the qualification did not check any independent source. The headline reports nine injured, but the body itemizes six injured in the suburbs, two men injured in Saltivskyi district, and one woman diagnosed with an acute stress reaction in Besarabivka, and the report does not reconcile these counts. The drone identifications stay preliminary, the damage assessment remains open, and no exact occurrence time appears for the individual strikes. The regional point locates the reported strikes only within Kharkiv Oblast.
